pretexts: car wrapping job earning $300-$500 per week
caregiver, administrative assistant, or data entry clerk position
freelance job to boost products, apps or videos
financial agent or client manager position
mystery shopper, quality control officer, or personal assistant
work-from-home running online stores or completing web surveys
processing orders or managing inventory for e-commerce platform
interac_context: In the financial agent scam, victims receive e-transfers or wire transfers into their bank account and are then directed to send money through Bitcoin to a company representative.
emerging_tactics: fraudulent software installation for fake job tasks
fake online platforms showing false earnings balances
small initial payouts to build trust
money mule recruitment through job offers

kill_chain_signals.contact: Fraudsters send unsolicited messages via email, text, WhatsApp, Messenger, or social media after victims post resumes on job recruitment websites
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Using names of real companies in Canada, fraudsters offer freelance job opportunities to boost products, complete tasks, wrap cars, or work as mystery shoppers
kill_chain_signals.payment: Victims deposit funds into crypto accounts or wallets, pay upgrade fees, or receive and forward counterfeit cheques through their bank accounts
kill_chain_signals.movement: Victims are directed to withdraw funds and deposit into specific bank accounts, send Bitcoin to company representatives, or forward e-transfers
kill_chain_signals.cashout: Victims see funds in their crypto account but cannot withdraw the funds they deposited and earned; counterfeit cheques bounce leaving victims responsible

red_flags: A company uses a web-based email instead of an official business domain
You receive a job offer you did not apply for
The job requires upfront deposits, upgrade fees, or unlock payments
You see a balance on the website or app but cannot withdraw it
You are asked to receive or forward money through your bank account
key_quote: You will see funds in your crypto account, but you will not have the ability to withdraw the funds you have deposited and earned.
title: Job
